title: Lozenge and comfit manufacturer to His Majesty the King.
html_source:
An advert (Gifford page 156).

Homer had the Lestrygonian episode situated between two headlands – Joyce has religious and secular authority sandwiching Leopold from the off in this episode (Ellmann, R. Ulysses on the Liffey,p74).

Pineapple rock, lemon platt, butter scotch. A sugarsticky girl shovelling scoopfuls of creams for a christian brother. Some school treat. Bad for their tummies.
